# Diana Barry & Shirley

- [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) — Friend of — [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — close childhood friends who swore eternal friendship · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P0](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share a tearful goodbye near the spring after Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forbids [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Devastated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed by her classmates, though [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) remains forced to keep her distance. Channeling her emotions into her studies, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enters a fierce academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P3](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers she has won the Avery Scholarship, while [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) wins the medal, and she subsequently celebrates her success at commencement with her loved ones. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reconnects with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and learns that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) plans to teach locally instead of attending [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). She also notes signs of aging and ill health in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), enjoying a serene evening walk with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) in the pasture before hardship strikes.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P17](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can go to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts the plan and resigns her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for college while helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) plan her wedding, receiving visits and commentary from [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and Charlotta the Fourth. She discusses the romance of the marriage with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before discovering [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) together in the garden. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love, change, and her own future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for Miss Lavendar's wedding to [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). After a joyful ceremony and farewell send-off, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, romantic moment together outside the stone house as a new chapter of life begins.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
